faq.titulo: What you need to know before you start

items.pregunta: Do I need to obtain authorization for my own facility?
items.respuesta: No. You can use Séance’s ANMAT-authorized warehouse and Technical Director under the agreed arrangement. Before we begin, we assess the authorizations, registrations and responsibilities that apply to each party, based on the products and the operation.

items.pregunta: What documentation do I need to provide?
items.respuesta: To assess your project, we need information about the products, country of origin, manufacturer, formulas or ingredient lists, and available labels. We then specify the technical documentation and studies required for each product.

items.pregunta: Who owns the brand and holds the registrations?
items.respuesta: Your brand remains yours. We define who holds the registrations and each party’s health regulatory responsibilities in writing at the outset, according to the operating arrangement and applicable requirements.

items.pregunta: How does this differ from full-service imports?
items.respuesta: Regulatory hosting provides an ANMAT-authorized warehouse, a Technical Director and regulatory support. With full-service imports, Séance imports directly from the country of origin, makes overseas payments, coordinates logistics, registers the products with ANMAT and performs quality controls. You focus on selling.

items.pregunta: Do you provide support after registration?
items.respuesta: Yes. Throughout our working relationship, we support documentation updates, reportable changes and health regulatory requirements within the agreed scope. We also define safety and traceability guidelines for products on the market.

items.pregunta: How is the service quoted and billed?
items.respuesta: We prepare the proposal based on the products, available documentation and scope of the operation. Before we begin, we set out our fees, billing arrangements and any additional expenses in writing so you can assess the cost of the service.

items.pregunta: What happens if our working relationship ends?
items.respuesta: We agree the termination terms in writing at the outset. These specify how documentation and any relevant regulatory procedures will be handled. Any change of establishment or registration holder is assessed against applicable requirements.

items.pregunta: How is my information protected?
items.respuesta: We work under confidentiality agreements to safeguard your technical and commercial information. We use the documentation to provide the service and carry out the relevant regulatory procedures within the agreed scope.

items.pregunta: What products can you import?
items.respuesta: We import cosmetics, fragrances and household and institutional hygiene products (domisanitarios). Our scope includes Grade II cosmetics in all categories. Before we begin, we assess each product and its documentation to establish the requirements for the operation.

items.pregunta: What information do you need to assess my project?
items.respuesta: Tell us which products you want to import, who manufactures them, their country of origin, estimated quantities and your intended timeline. Include formulas, labels and technical documentation if available. We will identify anything else needed to proceed.

items.pregunta: Does Séance pay the overseas supplier?
items.respuesta: Yes. As part of our full-service import offering, we make payments to the overseas supplier. We agree the currency, payment schedule and required funds in writing before starting the operation.

items.pregunta: How long does an import take?
items.respuesta: The timeline depends on the available documentation, product requirements, supplier lead times, transport and customs clearance. After assessing your project, we outline the stages and estimated times so you can plan the operation.

items.pregunta: How does this differ from regulatory hosting?
items.respuesta: Hosting provides an authorized warehouse, a Technical Director and regulatory support. Full-service imports add direct importing, overseas payments and logistics coordination. Choose this service if you want us to manage the entire process.

faq.titulo: What we get asked the most

items.pregunta: What does Laboratorio Séance do?
items.respuesta: We manufacture, import and register cosmetic, perfumery and household products in Argentina for brands and importers, with an active ANMAT authorization and full confidentiality.

items.pregunta: What is the minimum batch?
items.respuesta: 500 liters, or 5,000 units in formats under 100 ml. The higher the volume, the better the unit price.

items.pregunta: How long does it take to develop a new formula?
items.respuesta: Between 1 and 3 months, depending on complexity.

items.pregunta: How long does it take to register a cosmetic product in Argentina?
items.respuesta: With a complete dossier (signed documentation, reviewed labels and finished studies), ANMAT registration is granted in about 72 business hours, for both Grade I and Grade II. The real work is in preparing the dossier well, and that's what we take care of.

items.pregunta: How long does production take?
items.respuesta: About 4 weeks from the moment raw materials and packaging materials are on site.

items.pregunta: Do you work with Grade II products?
items.respuesta: Yes. We manufacture several Grade II categories in liquid, semi-solid and alcohol-based forms, and import Grade II cosmetics in every category.

items.pregunta: Can I bring my own formula?
items.respuesta: Yes. We adapt it to local regulations and to our plant equipment. The formula remains yours and is never shared or reused.

items.pregunta: Who holds the registration?
items.respuesta: Always the client. Séance provides the regulatory backing; ownership and commercialization never change hands.

items.pregunta: Do you sign non-disclosure agreements?
items.respuesta: Yes, we do.

items.pregunta: Do you manufacture household products?
items.respuesta: Yes. We hold an active authorization and manufacture room, textile and car fresheners.

items.pregunta: Do you import household products?
items.respuesta: Yes, we are authorized to do so.

items.pregunta: Do I need to know how ANMAT works to work with you?
items.respuesta: No. We give you a free initial consultation, understand your project and tell you exactly which path to follow.

items.pregunta: Do you manufacture for international brands without a structure in Argentina?
items.respuesta: Yes. Through our hosting service for importers, you operate legally in Argentina without needing a local entity.

items.pregunta: Which languages do you work in?
items.respuesta: Spanish and English.

items.pregunta: How long do you take to reply to a request?
items.respuesta: We reply to complete requests within 72 business hours at the latest.

items.pregunta: Where are you located?
items.respuesta: At Directorio 3548, Caseros, Buenos Aires, Argentina.
